citation: Engeroff et al. 2024. Investigating effects of FFP2 wearing during physical activity on gas exchange, metabolism and affective state using a randomized controlled trial. Scientific Reports
protocol: Cycling at 40, 50 and 70% VO2max for 10 min each, with FFP2 mask and without, separated by 48 h; spirometry breath-by-breath
population: 13 healthy adults (6 F, 7 M), age 31.3 +/- 5.5 y
note: Table 3 gives mean and SD per stage and mask condition; Table 2 gives baseline values with ANOVA statistics. Steady stages with %VO2max stated.
